blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 113 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 16, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DCBO & CDW lead 113 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 32 Canadian and 81 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 16, 2026) found 113 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 32 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 10 of them new to the list this week. Docebo Inc. (DCBO) leads with a +82% six-month return, and Industrials is the most represented sector with 7 names.

In the U.S., 81 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 2 of them new to the list this week. CDW Corporation (CDW) leads with a +57% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 20 names.
